method.motion: Numerical first-order response with a modest current, not Gazebo
method.mapping_truth: Analytic seabed_height fixture; not the Gazebo seabed/structures
method.network_fault: auv_1 acoustic-link blackout; its autonomy continues running
method.classification: Untrained synthetic feature/template baseline with synthetic class-tag silhouette cues
method.reproducibility: Same sensor and navigation seeds; network paths diverge after packet-loss draws.
method.claim_limit: These measurements do not validate real sensing, trained AI, physical protection, Gazebo physics, or hardware.

metrics.classifier: synthetic feature/template baseline; no trained AI

classification.scope: Synthetic acoustic templates and class-tag silhouette cues; untrained baseline.

tracking_at_end.association: Greedy one-to-one position association within 4 m; truth IDs unused by tracker.

checks.name: finite_bounded_commands
checks.criterion: All command components finite; maximum commanded speed <= 1.3 m/s.

checks.name: auv_separation
checks.criterion: Minimum pairwise AUV centre separation >= 2.4 m.

checks.name: wildlife_clearance
checks.criterion: Synthetic wildlife and AUV surfaces stay >= 0.8 m apart.

checks.name: seabed_clearance
checks.criterion: Synthetic AUV surface stays >= 1 m above the analytic seabed.

checks.name: diver_clearance
checks.criterion: Every AUV stays at least 2.4 m from the diver centre.

checks.name: mapping_accuracy
checks.criterion: Observed analytic-harness seabed elevation RMSE <= one map voxel.

checks.name: sensor_position_accuracy
checks.criterion: Synthetic sonar detection position RMSE <= 1 m.

checks.name: synthetic_classifier
checks.criterion: At least 10 synthetic detections and classification accuracy >= 0.75.

checks.name: capacity_and_queues
checks.criterion: Transmitted bytes including headers fit scheduled slot capacity; queues <= configured maximum.

checks.name: delivery_ratio
checks.criterion: Deduplicated delivered / transmitted packets is within [0, 1].

checks.name: approach_alert_before_entry
checks.criterion: A warning/critical alert associated geometrically with the approaching object precedes its 4 m zone entry.

checks.name: stale_peer_expiry
checks.criterion: Other nodes remove auv_1 telemetry after its 4 s freshness limit; evaluated only for outage windows > 4.4 s.

checks.name: loss_stress_changes_delivery
checks.criterion: High-loss observed packet delivery ratio is lower for runs with at least 20 transmitted packets per scenario.
